method: Visual inspection of production-loader four-view geometry plots and unchanged manufacturer photo overlays. No WebGL or physical-fit claim.
observations: AMOLED1.43 unscaled 689-component native assembly retained, front circular optical surface unobstructed; 34 drawing groups. Published thickness differs from CAD and is retained as conflict.
AMOLED1.43-B adds only explicitly unverified shell from 2D dimensions, broad debugging cutouts; no fabricated side actuator geometry or 3D button binding.
AMOLED2.06 external dimension reconstruction only; no exact C6 native CAD, internal PCB marked UNKNOWN and inspected by loader exploded visibility check.
Both 1.69 variants visibly show UNKNOWN reverse board; thickness and rounded optical corners are estimates.
Touch1.47 bare/M retain original native geometry, distinguish header presence, and retain unchanged source-photo registration. Photo/model registration does not establish heights or physical fit.
